Coram : DIPAK MISRA*, A.M. KHANWILKAR, MOHAN M. SHANTANAGOUDAR
A B Child and Family welfare - High Court issued writ for production of minor daughter allegedly removed by mother-appellant C from custody of father-respondent no.2 from U.K. - High Court directed the mother to produce her daughter and to comply with the order of High Court of 3 weeks or in alternative to handover the custody of daughter to father within 3 weeks from date of order - Whether the return of the minor to her native state would be in the interests of the minor - Held: The Courts in India D are not denuded from declining the relief to return the child to the
Decision Date : 03-07-2017 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 972/2017 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 3 Judges
